# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple iterations |
| IncrementalPlanner | incremental_planner.py | Determines next test increment using LLM |
| TDDCycleRunner | tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one TDD cycle with GREEN retry and optional reflection |
| PythonLanguagePod | python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python, delegates code gen and execution |
| WorkerAgent | worker_agent.py | Generates code (test/implementation/refactor) via LLM |
| PodmanOrchestrator | podman_orchestrator.py | Executes code in isolated container, verifies hash integrity |
| PodmanRunner | podman_runner.py | Rootless Podman container lifecycle and pulse execution |
| PlaybookManager | playbook/manager.py | Creates, retrieves, updates playbooks and bullets with persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and experiments to PostgreSQL/SQLite |
| Reflector | core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes generator outputs and extracts error patterns and insights |
| Curator | core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook bullets |
| Generator | core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| ImportFilter | agents/import_filter.py | Validates generated code for forbidden imports and builtins |
| BulletRetriever | playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval of relevant playbook bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | playbook/deduplication.py | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| BulletClusterer | playbook/clustering.py | DBSCAN-based clustering of semantically related bullets |
| DistillationRouter | playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| DomainRegistry | playbook/distillation_router.py | Manages domain signatures and classification |
| ContextGraphRetriever | retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ retrieval with context-aware ranking and reasoning |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval for code generation |
| LLMClient | utils/llm_client.py | Unified interface for multiple LLM providers |
| ContextMapBuilder | utils/context_map.py | Builds AST context map from source files |
| PlaybookQA | playbook/qa.py | Answers coding questions using playbook knowledge |
| PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | reliability/playbook_analyzer.py | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN success |
| TDDCycleAnalyzer | reliability/tdd_cycle_analyzer.py | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trends |
| AdaptiveBroker | broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| PerformanceAggregator | broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates agent metrics from audit trail |
| AuditStore | audit/store.py | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| EnsembleLearner | ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multi-model learning and cross-voting |
| ConsensusBuilder | ensemble/consensus.py | Builds consensus bullets from clustered model proposals |
| VotingSystem | ensemble/voting.py | Implements weighted, majority, supermajority voting strategies |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector
    participant Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager

    User->>Runner: run(feature_requirement)
    loop until planner says COMPLETE or max iterations
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
        activate Orchestrator
        Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult (passed=False)
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orchestrator
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        alt GREEN with retries
            loop up to max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: test_code, impl_file: impl_code})
                activate Orchestrator
                Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container-->>Orchestrator: PulseResult
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orchestrator
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                Note right of Cycle: exits if green_result.passed or abort
                break
            end
        else ABORT
            Note right of Cycle: SecurityBreach or ForbiddenImport
        end

        alt green_result.passed
            Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse(files)
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: refactor_result
            Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
            deactivate Pod

            opt Learning loop
                Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                activate Reflector
                Reflector-->>Cycle: reflector_output
                deactivate Reflector
                Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                activate Curator
                Curator-->>Cycle: curator_output
                deactivate Curator
                Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                activate Playbook
                Playbook-->>Cycle: added_bullet_ids
                deactivate Playbook
            end
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        deactivate Cycle
        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
    end
    Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
```
